text:
Anya (Design): Quick design review: create key modal — proposed change to post-create confirmation. Currently we show a toast + inline secret drawer. Thinking we need an explicit 'Download secret' CTA, plus a soft-delete 'Undo' affordance for ~10s. Also want an accessible banner so screen readers don't miss it. Thoughts? Sam (Product): +1 on a clear Download CTA. My worry is copy clutter in the modal. Suggest concise copy: "Download the key now — this is the only time you'll see it." and keep other guidance in the empty-state / docs link. Mike (Engineering): From infra POV: Undo via soft-delete is fine, but ensure we create an audit log entry for create + undo. Also: toasts are easy to miss if user navigates away. We should consider an anchored banner (aria-live) in the console header area that persists for the undo window. Jess (Accessibility): Agree with Mike. Toasts are often ignored by screen readers. Recommend an aria-live='assertive' region with role=status that announces "Key created. Undo available." and include keyboard-focusable Undo link. Also ensure keyboard focus lands on the secret drawer 'Copy' button so keyboard users can immediately copy without hunting. Sam (Product): UX nit on CTA ordering: primary button in modal — should it be 'Done' or 'Download'? Most users finish the setup and don't want to download. Maybe primary = "Done" and a prominent secondary/inline "Download"? Open to opinions. Anya (Design): Proposal: keep primary as 'Done' (consistency with other modals). Make 'Download' very visible inside the drawer (large button) and add an ephemeral, anchored banner with the Undo link. This keeps modal flow clean and surfaces the critical action. Mike (Engineering): Edge case — orgs with RBAC: if a user lacks create perms but can view keys, we must show disabled CTA + clear tooltip explaining permission. Do not hide the control entirely; show disabled with guidance. Server should still return 403 for disallowed creates. Jess (Accessibility): Suggested disabled tooltip copy: "Requires API key admin role. Contact your org admin to create keys." Make sure the tooltip is keyboard-accessible (focusable) and reads with a screen reader. Anya (Design): I'll mock two variants: Variant A: assertive banner anchored under top nav with Undo (10s), plus drawer with Download/Copy. Variant B: standard toast + modal drawer (current baseline) but with improved toast aria attributes and a persistent small banner on the console. I'll put both in Figma and share. Sam (Product): :thumbsup: Also add a short line in the empty-state for keys about long-lived vs ephemeral keys — we've had a few support tickets where customers created the wrong type. Keep it single-sentence w/ link to docs. deploy-bot: deploy:staging finished building feature/key-create-undo — preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/feature/key-create-undo Mike (Engineering): tiny React snippet for the anchored announce region we discussed: ```
Key created. Undo
``` Make sure focus doesn't unexpectedly jump — only move focus if it's necessary for the task. Jess (Accessibility): Prefer not to force focus jump. Use aria-describedby on the modal title to reference the success message if the user stays in the modal. If we land them back on the console, then an assertive region at top is fine. Anya (Design): Thanks all — I'll iterate on copy + placement and post updated mocks by EOD. Tagging @DesignReview for signoff when ready.
